title: From 10 December the connections between Switzerland and Italy were interrupted
subtitle: From 10 December 2020 until further notice, SBB and Trenitalia will cut off the connections between Switzerland and Italy. The decision is linked to a decree (Dpcm) of the Italian authorities. Both long-distance and regional TILO traffic are affected by the measure. SBB / TILO trains run right up to the border. Trains in regional traffic between Brig and Domodossola continue to run.
author: La Redazione
body:
From 10 December 2020 until further notice, SBB and Trenitalia will cut off the connections between Switzerland and Italy. The decision is linked to a decree (Dpcm) of the Italian authorities. Both long-distance and regional TILO traffic are affected by the measure. SBB / TILO trains run right up to the border. Trains in regional traffic between Brig and Domodossola continue to run.
